#!/bin/sh
# analyze.sh WORKSPACE LIMIT
# Sum only values strictly greater than LIMIT from $WORKSPACE/flow/measured.txt,
# sleep 60 seconds, then write the integer alone to $WORKSPACE/result.txt.
set -eu

WS="$1"
LIMIT="$2"
IN="$WS/flow/measured.txt"
OUT="$WS/result.txt"

if [ ! -f "$IN" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "missing measured input: $IN" >&2
  exit 3
fi

sum=$(awk -v lim="$LIMIT" '
  {
    v = $1 + 0
    if (v > lim) s += v
  }
  END { printf "%d", s + 0 }
' "$IN")

printf 'computed sum=%s (strict cutoff LIMIT=%s) from %s\n' "$sum" "$LIMIT" "$IN" >&2

# Knowledge contract: sleep 60 seconds before publishing, so the Job has a
# bounded active interval during which an engineer can intervene.
sleep 60

printf '%s\n' "$sum" > "$OUT"

#!/bin/sh
# analyze.sh WORKSPACE LIMIT
# Sum only values strictly greater than LIMIT from $WORKSPACE/flow/measured.txt,
# sleep 60 seconds, then write the integer alone to $WORKSPACE/result.txt.
set -eu

WS="$1"
LIMIT="$2"
IN="$WS/flow/measured.txt"
OUT="$WS/result.txt"

if [ ! -f "$IN" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "missing measured input: $IN" >&2
  exit 3
fi

sum=$(awk -v lim="$LIMIT" '
  {
    v = $1 + 0
    if (v > lim) s += v
  }
  END { printf "%d", s + 0 }
' "$IN")

printf 'computed sum=%s (strict cutoff LIMIT=%s) from %s\n' "$sum" "$LIMIT" "$IN" >&2

# Knowledge contract: sleep 60 seconds before publishing, so the Job has a
# bounded active interval during which an engineer can intervene.
sleep 60

printf '%s\n' "$sum" > "$OUT"
printf 'wrote %s\n' "$OUT" >&2
